title: Lower Endpoint of a Round-Orbit Head Range
statement: Let $R$ be a round contract for a $k$-tape Turing machine $M$, let $i$ be an index in its index type, let $c$ be a configuration, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $j$ be a work-tape index. Write $c_r$ for the configuration obtained by iterating the round orbit from $c$ exactly $r$ times, using the duration specified by $R$. The lower endpoint is the minimum of the prescribed lower bounds $R.lo(i,c_r,j)$ for $0 \le r < n$ together with the position of the head on tape $j$ in $c_n$.
